description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes US petroleum imports at company level from Form EIA-814, the Monthly Imports Report. The page, read on 2026-09-26, offers the June 2026 data (released 31 August 2026, next release 30 September 2026), monthly files for 2026, and yearly files of historical imports by month including final revisions from 1986 to 2025, as XLSX from 2016 and XLS before. Explanatory notes are linked, along with the Petroleum Supply Monthly and a crude import tracking tool. Files are free to download; as US government works they are in the public domain and EIA asks for acknowledgement. Caveats: the page read does not list the columns, so the level of detail per shipment (port, origin, product) should be checked in the explanatory notes before use. Simulation uses are tracing which importers and entry points supply US refineries, for supply chain network flow models and resilience studies of import disruptions. Related records: data-eia-petroleum-supply-and-prices gives imports by country of origin and PAD district.
